column1: # Manual adjudication of every secretscan finding on the package corpora
# (bench/fetch-corpus.sh). Each finding was inspected in its source file.
#   value      secret value regex (values are public package contents)
# example-credential: real credential *material* (keys, passwords, tokens) that
# is a documented example or test fixture in a published package. Reporting it
# is correct; it is not live. not-a-secret: the value is not credential material
# at all (an identifier, digest, algorithm name, placeholder), i.e. a false positive.
